Tasty and healthy Indian food
May 2026 • Family
Visited this place for its ratings and’s accessibility from my hotel, but I was pleasantly surprised with this place. They have plenty of vegetarian and non vegetarian options and the best part they keep their utensils separate. The food itself was good quality and we didn’t have any health issues especially since we were travelling with senior citizens and a kid. Definitely worth visiting. And it caters to Indian and foreign taste buds.
